title: Flow Matching
core_mech: 在已知 probability path 上回归 velocity（而非 score），再直接积分神经 ODE 完成分布运输。
core_mech_en: Trains continuous normalizing flows without ODE simulation by directly regressing the marginal vector field u_t(x) along conditional probability paths.
input_desc: 源分布样本 x0（通常高斯噪声）与数据样本 x1
input_en: Source prior sample x_0 ~ p_0 and target data sample x_1 ~ p_1 interpolated along a conditional path x_t
output_desc: 沿学习 ODE 从源分布运输得到的生成样本
output_en: Samples generated by integrating the learned velocity field dx/dt = v_θ(x_t, t) from t=0 to t=1

source.title: Flow Matching

adapter.name: Flow Matching
adapter.mechanism: Conditional optimal-transport Gaussian path and analytical velocity regression require no training-time ODE solve.
limitations: Small positive sigma_min leaves endpoint smoothing; this is the conditional OT path, not every flow-matching variant.
Synthetic teaching data only; no clinical validity or published benchmark is claimed.
